mechanism_narrative: A rebound in WORKPLACES after a sharp one-week drop pulls weekday foot traffic back into commercial corridors and raises RETAIL_REC over the next month. If commuting stabilizes instead of recovering, the retail lift does not materialize.

evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell from -13.3 at t-1w to -23.6 at t-0w while TRANSIT stayed near -43
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its last-4-week mean even after WORKPLACES rises for two consecutive weeks and TRANSIT improves by at least 3 points.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent weakness in TRANSIT suppresses spontaneous shopping trips by limiting access to retail districts, so RETAIL_REC declines further over the next two weeks whenever transit remains deeply negative. The effect fails if transit recovers while retail does not.
